card.name: Small words in HIV and herpes drug text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, of and reducing, and the space before a number, in HIV-1 or herpes antiviral label text. They come just before a disease or drug term such as resistance, hepatitis B or genital herpes.

modes.label: Linking word before a condition
modes.description: The word of or to sits between a noun and a disease or drug name in antiviral labeling.
modes.example: in the presence<< of>> concurrent infection with hepatitis B virus.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank token just before a dose amount or virus type number.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in HIV and herpes drug labels, just before the disease or drug name comes up.
